heroHeadline: Day 96: Michoacán AG Confirms 60+ CJNG Colombian Mercenaries in Purépecha Plateau; Plan Kukulkan 13 Days; El Sapo At Large
heroSubtitle: Day 96 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). CJNG COLOMBIAN MERCENARIES — PURÉPECHA PLATEAU (Day 96): Michoacán's state attorney general (FGE) formally confirmed 60+ Colombian paramilitary operatives embedded with CJNG forces across the Purépecha indigenous highlands — 10 municipalities targeted (Zamora, Jacona, Tangamandapio, Chilchota, Charapan, Paracho, Cherán, Nahuatzen, Los Reyes, Tangancícuaro). Cell operates in 8–10 pickup trucks, contesting the Canyon of the Eleven Pueblos and Sierra de los Reyes corridors against the Los Reyes Cartel and Knights Templar remnants. Recent incidents: May 20 — 3 CJNG killed on Cocucho–Ocumicho road; May 17 — 2 community police killed in Sevina, Nahuatzen. The Purépecha deployment adds a third active CJNG indigenous-community front in Michoacán alongside the Aquila coastal corridor (Nahua communities, 7+ attacks since May 19) and Tierra Caliente. CJNG's use of Colombian/Guatemalan former combatants in personal security and tactical roles — previously documented for El Sapo's detail — is now confirmed at the platoon-level in Michoacán highlands. PLAN KUKULKAN — 13 DAYS: Thirteen days remain before the FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match (June 11, Estadio Azteca, Mexico City vs. South Africa). SEDENA confirmed on May 27 Plan Kukulkan is proceeding as planned: 99,000+ personnel deployed (20,000 Armed Forces, 55,000 federal/state police, 188 canine units, 2,100 military vehicles, 24 aircraft/drones). Guadalajara (Akron Stadium, 4 matches) under heightened CJNG-specific protocols; U.S. special forces training Mexican military on stadium attack prevention and drone bomb defense. EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 96: Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large as Mexico's #1 CJNG enforcement target — no capture or elimination reported. MANZANILLO COMMAND VOID — DAY 20: 20 days since El Chucky's arrest (May 9), no confirmed successor plaza boss. CIAGATE FGR INVESTIGATION (Day 96): Ongoing — Mullin-Sheinbaum 'coordination without subordination' framework active; June bilateral meeting scheduled. DOJ TERRORISM PRECEDENT (May 16): First-ever cartel operative charged under 'material support of terrorism' statutes (María del Rosario Navarro Sánchez). SUCCESSION BINARY: El 03 (confirmed leader) vs. El Sapo (military wing, at large). DECAPITATION LEDGER: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested Mar 11), El Jardinero (arrested Apr 27; extradition suspended), El Güero Conta (arrested Apr 27), El Chipo/Jorge N (arrested May 19), El Cabo (arrested May 7), El Chucky/Manzanillo (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate (arrested May 13). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials. 47+ CJNG HVTs neutralized.
